objective: Expand the deterministic baseline from one pick/place task into a diverse semantic-task benchmark without exposing joint, firmware, or hardware control.
acceptance: offline planner supports place, kitting, inspection, and clear-then-place task families using semantic actions only
expanded scenarios cover at least three non-baseline task families
kitting verification checks missing parts, extra parts, confidence, and evidence
evaluation reports task-family coverage and complex-task rate
dashboard fixtures visibly demonstrate multi-object, inspection, and recovery tasks
stop_conditions: a frozen interface change is required
raw joint, CAN, emergency-stop, or firmware access would be introduced
scripted results could be mistaken for physical robot evidence
